question: How is each individual power further divided within its grade?
premises: The division occurs in many ways.
Distinctions begin with lordship of knowledge and so on.
inference: Each individual power is further divided in many ways, beginning with lordship of knowledge and similar distinctions.
uncertainties: bhadataḥ appears where bhedātaḥ might be expected; surface kept as given
plain_english: Each one is divided in many ways, by distinctions such as lordship of knowledge and so on.
